title: Descent of a morphism property through an fppf sheaf surjection
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and let $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z$ be morphisms of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $P$ be any one of flatness [def-weil-flat-morphism], local finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], or local finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], extended to algebraic spaces by etale scheme charts. Suppose $v\circ u$ has $P$ and $u$ is a surjection of sheaves on the big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site]: for every scheme $T/S$ and every $y\in Y(T)$ there is an fppf covering $\{T_i\to T\}$ and sections $x_i\in X(T_i)$ with $u(x_i)=y|_{T_i}$. Then $v$ has $P$. This assertion is separate for each of the three properties. No flatness, local finite type, local finite presentation, or quasi-compactness of $u$ is assumed.

proof.text: Choose surjective etale scheme charts $W\to Z$ and $V\to Y_W=Y\times_ZW$. Put $X_W=X\times_ZW$ and $A=X_W\times_{Y_W}V=X\times_YV$, and choose a surjective etale scheme chart $U\to A$. The fibre-product lemma ensures these are algebraic spaces; the definition supplies their charts. The map $A\to X_W$ is the base change of $V\to Y_W$, so the representable-etale scheme-test lemma makes $U\to X_W$ surjective etale. Apply the chart-test criterion to $X\to Z$ with charts $W$ and $U\to X_W$: the scheme composite $U\to V\to W$ has $P$.

source.place: Tag 06NR, lemma-curiosity, proof; scheme descent is Tag 06NB in descent.tex.

proof.text: Apply the assumed local lifting property of $u$ to the section $V\to Y$. Obtain an fppf covering $\{V_i\to V\}$ and maps $x_i:V_i\to X$ over $Y$. Pair $x_i$ with the given $V_i\to V$ to obtain $t_i:V_i\to A=X\times_YV$. Set $D_i=V_i\times_{A}U$. By representable surjective etale base change, $D_i$ is a scheme and $D_i\to V_i$ is surjective etale. The covering-calculus lemma, clauses (1), (3), (4), makes $\{D_i\to V_i\to V\}$ an fppf covering of schemes. Each arrow factors through $U\to V$: on $D_i$ the two maps to $A$ agree, so their projections to $V$ agree. Thus this family refines the single arrow $U\to V$ without requiring any property of that arrow.

source.place: Tag 06NR, lemma-curiosity, proof; scheme descent is Tag 06NB in descent.tex.

proof.text: Apply the scheme refinement-descent lemma to $U\to V\to W$, the covering just constructed, and $P(U\to W)$ from step 1. It gives $P(V\to W)$. Apply the chart-test criterion to $Y\to Z$ with the chosen charts $W\to Z$ and $V\to Y_W$ to conclude $P(v)$. The same argument applies separately to each of the three allowed properties.
